item.title: STF não ordenou volta de Bolsonaro ao regime fechado após suposto desacato
item.description: O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) não determinou que o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, em prisão domiciliar desde novembro de 2025, retorne ao regime fechado, como afirmam posts.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) não determinou que o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, em prisão domiciliar desde novembro de 2025, retorne ao regime fechado, como afirmam posts. “Urgente: Jair Bolsonaro é preso por desacato à autoridade e será enviado de volta para a Papuda”, dizem postagens que passaram a circular no Facebook e no Instagram neste domingo, após a vitória do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) sobre Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). O STF negou à Reuters que tenha havido uma decisão da Corte neste sentido. A determinação também não consta no processo de execução penal do ex-presidente, que cumpre pena de mais de 27 anos de prisão por tentar dar um golpe de Estado em 2022. A defesa do político disse por mensagem que “desconhece” uma ordem para que ele volte ao regime fechado e o alegado episódio de desacato. Até ser enviado para a prisão domiciliar , Bolsonaro foi mantido na prisão da Papudinha, que faz parte do Complexo Penitenciário da Papuda. A Polícia Militar do Distrito Federal, que administra a Papudinha, disse que a alegação sobre o retorno do ex-presidente "não procede". No fim da tarde desta segunda-feira, Flávio Bolsonaro publicou um vídeo em seu Instagram dizendo que havia visitado o pai em casa pela manhã. (Texto atualizado em 26 de outubro de 2026 com resposta da Polícia Militar do Distrito Federal e informação sobre visita de Flávio a Jair Bolsonaro.) VEREDICTO Falso. O STF, a defesa de Bolsonaro e a Polícia Militar do Distrito Federal negaram que o ex-presidente tenha sido enviado de volta ao regime fechado após um suposto episódio de desacato à autoridade. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: ブラジル金融市場大荒れ、ルラ大統領再選で財政運営警戒
item.description:
Rodrigo Campos Marcela Ayres Karin Strohecker
[ニューヨーク／ブラジリア...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ブラジル金融市場大荒れ、ルラ大統領再選で財政運営警戒 4:18 配信

１０月２６日、ブラジル・サンパウロのパウリスタ通りで撮影　REUTERS/Brian Snyder

Rodrigo Campos　Marcela Ayres　Karin Strohecker

[ニューヨーク／ブラジリア　２６日　ロイター] - ブラジルで２５日に行われた大統領選の決選投票で、左派で現職のルラ大統領が右派のフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員を破り再選を果たしたことを受け、２６日のブラジル金融市場は株価とレアル相場が急落するなど大荒れの展開となった。

オックスフォード・エコノミクスの中南米担当シニアエコノミスト、マウリシオ・モンヘ氏は「ルラ氏の勝利を受け、ルラ氏の４期目政権下での財政見通しを巡る見直しが市場で進み、急激な売りが広がった」と指摘。「ルラ氏にとって最大の課題は、実質賃金の上昇と雇用拡大を優先しながら、信頼性があり持続可能な財政再建の実現は可能だと市場を納得させることだ」と述べた。

ＩＮＧのストラテジスト、クリス・ターナー氏は「国内金融市場にとって重要なのは、ボルソナロ氏がどれだけ早く選挙結果を受け入れるか、少なくとも憲法に基づく手続きの進行を容認することだ」と指摘。市場はまた、ルラ氏の財務相人事にも注目。ＲＢＣブルーベイ・アセット・マネジメントのグラハム・ストック氏は「次期ルラ政権が財政規律を維持する意思を示すかが市場にとって最大の焦点になっている。その第一歩となるのが、今後数週間以内に行われる新財務相の任命だ」と述べた。

２６日の株式市場では、ブラジルの主要株価指数のボベスパ指数が一時１５％超下落。１日当たりの下落率としては１９９８年以来最大の下落率となる可能性がある。ブラジル証券取引所を運営するＢ３は、ボベスパ指数が前営業日終値から１０％下落したことを受けサーキットブレーカーが発動され、株式売買を３０分間停止したと発表した。

外国為替市場では、ブラジルレアルが対ドルで一時１１％超下落。１日当たりの下落率としては過去最大級になる可能性がある。

売りはブラジル国債にも波及。２０５４年償還債など超長期債を中心に大きく売られた。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのデータによると、ブラジルの５年物クレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ）保証料率は１５１．６７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）に上昇。前週末終値の１２０．２１ｂｐから大幅に拡大した。ＣＤＳは国債の債務不履行（デフォルト）に対する保険コストの指標とされる。

市場が急落する中、ブラジル財務省は２７日に予定していた物価連動国債の入札と、２９日に予定していた固定利付国債の入札を中止した。

item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（26日） 3:55 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

上昇して取引を終えた。幅広い銘柄に買い注文が入り、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は反発。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は１．０９％高と続伸した。人工知能（ＡＩ）開発投資への警戒感が根強い中、米アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請の動きが好感された。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は５．２８％高。エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは６．１％、防衛大手ＢＡＥシステムズは４．１％それぞれ上昇した。

テクノロジー・サービスプロバイダーのコンピュータセンターは堅調な利益見通しを示し、１３．１％高。プライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）ファンドの３ｉグループは２．６％上昇した。

一方、石油・ガス株指数は０．８９％安。石油大手のＢＰは１．２％、シェルは０．８％それぞれ下落した。

今週は、ヒーリー英財務相による初の予算案発表を２８日に控える。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が開催する連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）にも注目が集まっている。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

反発して取引を終えた。堅調な企業業績見通しが相次いで発表され、投資家の期待感が相場を後押しした。ドイツのＤＡＸ指数は０．９１％高。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は２．６４％高。旅行・娯楽関連株指数は１．９２％上昇。一方、石油・ガス株指数は０．１９％下落した。

テクノロジー・サービスプロバイダーのコンピュータセンターは通期利益見通しが市場予想を上回り、１３．１％上昇。大腸がん治療薬の臨床試験のデータを発表したデンマークのバイオ医薬品会社ジェンマブは１２．１％値上がりした。

ドイツのＩＦＯ経済研究所が発表した１０月の業況指数は市場予想以上に改善した。

今週は、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）がそれぞれ金融政策決定会合を開く。市場では、ＥＣＢが政策金利を据え置き、１２月に利上げするとの観測が強い。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

フランス国債の価格が５月以来最大の上昇率を記録する勢いとなった。ムーディーズによる格下げを免れたほか、週末の抗議活動もおおむね前週のような騒乱に発展せず、国債売りに歯止めがかかった。

週内に欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金利決定を控え、原油価格の小幅下落も一部のユーロ圏国債を支えた。

フランス１０年国債（ＯＡＴ）利回りは約１１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し、４．９１５％となった。１日の低下幅としては５月下旬以来最大となる見通し。前週は５．１４１５％と、２４年ぶりの高水準に達していた。

独仏１０年債の利回り格差は１１ｂｐ縮小して１５５ｂｐとなった。前週には１７７．７ｂｐと、２０１１年以来の水準に拡大していた。

格付け会社ムーディーズは２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いた。

議会の分裂で財政再建が難航し、２０２７年の大統領選に向けた駆け引きも始まる中、仏政府にとって一定の安心材料となった。しかし、ＤＺ銀行のアナリスト、レネ・アルブレヒト氏は、フランス国債の重しとなっている財政問題は解消していないと指摘した。

ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ１０年国債利回りは１ｂｐ上昇し、３．３５％となった。

ＥＣＢの政策見通しの変化に敏感なドイツ２年国債利回りは５ｂｐ上昇し、３．０７５％となった。

ドイツ国債は前週、安全資産への資金逃避の主な受け皿の一つとなった。

item.title: Alibaba AI model secretly tried to reach Beijing server in test, rival Cohere says
item.description: Canadian AI company Cohere said on Monday one of Alibaba's Qwen AI models tried to send data to an Alibaba Cloud storage server in Beijing during a security test.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Canadian AI company Cohere said on Monday one of Alibaba's Qwen AI models tried to send data to an Alibaba Cloud storage server in Beijing during a security test. The model made the attempt even though its own reasoning indicated it would not do such a thing, Cohere said. Alibaba was not immediately available for comment outside regular business hours. Cohere, which sells its own AI models to businesses and governments as a "sovereign AI" provider, competes with open-weight models such as Alibaba's Qwen, which anyone can download and run on their own servers Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next was asked to write a rule to detect malicious file download, but instead took stock of the machine it was running on and tried to send a test file to the Beijing server, Cohere said Cohere's test environment had no connection to the internet and blocked the attempt but the company said the request could have reached the server on a developer's laptop or a system with normal network access The behavior was rare, occurring in fewer than one in 100,000 actions across Cohere's tests, but a service handling 10 million agent actions a week could see as many as 100 such attempts, Cohere said The Canadian AI platform said it could not determine whether the behavior was deliberate or a leftover from the model's training, such as unscrubbed data from the environments where it was trained Chinese models accounted for 41% of downloads on AI platform Hugging Face over the past year, more than any other country's, according to the platform’s spring 2026 report

item.title: Libya says international aviation restrictions lifted after 11 years
item.description: Libya's Ministry of Transport said on Monday that airspace restrictions issued by the UN's International Civil Aviation Organization in 2015 during the country's civil war have been removed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Libya's Ministry of Transport said on Monday that airspace restrictions issued by the UN's International Civil Aviation Organization in 2015 during the country's civil war have been removed. The ministry said the decision, which was formally issued on October 23, was announced by ICAO Secretary General Juan Carlos Salazar at the opening of a meeting of civil aviation officials from the Middle East in Doha. "This measure comes as a result of the notable progress made and the confidence placed in the capabilities of the Libyan civil aviation sector in recent times," the Tripoli-based Ministry of Transport said in a statement on its verified Facebook page. The ministry, in a separate statement, said the North African country has received requests for permits to transit Libyan airspace that it characterized as "unprecedented demand from international airlines." "The total number of permits registered for 2026-2027 winter season has surged to 61,968 flights per month, effective from this November," the ministry said, calling it a significant jump from an average of 2,000 transit flights per month during the 2025-2026 season. "Such an increase will generate substantial financial revenues using Libyan airspace," it added. Libya slid into chaos after the fall of Muammar Gaddafi in a NATO-backed uprising in 2011. Three years later, a civil war broke out between armed factions vying for power and divided the country between eastern and western administrations. The war caused damage to up to 20 aircraft, including Airbus (AIR.PA) models, at Tripoli International Airport in 2014. There are currently few airlines operating flights in and out of Libya, and they have long been limited to destinations such as Tunisia, Jordan, Turkey, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Sudan. The ICAO's decision would be circulated to all 193 member states for their implementation, the ministry added.

item.title: 米天然ガス大手ＥＱＴ、130億ドルで同業買収 国内最大規模に
item.description:
Sumit Saha
[２６日 ロイター] - 米天然ガス大手のＥＱＴは２６日、同業レンジ・リソーシズを１３０億ドルの...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米天然ガス大手ＥＱＴ、130億ドルで同業買収　国内最大規模に 3:15 配信

米ペンシルベニア州エリーで開催されたイベントで講演するＥＱＴのトビー・ライス最高経営責任者。2024年9月撮影。REUTERS/Hannah Beier

Sumit Saha

[２６日 ロイター] - 米天然ガス大手のＥＱＴは２６日、同業レンジ・リソーシズを１３０億ドルの株式交換方式で買収すると発表した。米天然ガス需要が拡大する中、統合により米最大規模の天然ガス生産会社となる見通し。負債を含めた統合後の企業価値は５００億ドルを超える見込みで、取引は２０２７年１─３月期に完了する見込み。

統合後の経営はＥＱＴが主導し、本社も引き続き東部ペンシルベニア州に置く。レンジから最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）ら２人が取締役に加わる。ＥＱＴの株主は統合後の会社の約７３％を、レンジ株主は残り２７％をそれぞれ保有。５年間で計約２００億ドルのフリーキャッシュフローを生むと見込まれる。

米国では、液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）の輸出増や、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連データセンターからの電力需要の増加が顕著だ。米エネルギー情報局（ＥＩＡ）によると、米国内消費量は２５年の日量９１９億立方フィートから２７年に９４３億立方フィートに増える見通し。

ＥＱＴとレンジは、いずれもアパラチア盆地にガス資源を保有する。統合によってＥＱＴの収益力が改善するほか、掘削可能な資源を拡充。電力会社やＬＮＧの輸出業者などへの供給体制を強化する。

レンジの株主は、保有１株につきＥＱＴの０．９８７株を受け取る。ロイターの試算によると、株式価値は１２８億３０００万ドル（１株当たり５４．９１ドル）と、レンジ・リソーシズの２３日の終値に対して約２０．６％のプレミアムが付く。

item.title: 米マイクロソフト、約6万人対象に希望退職を募集 コスト抑制へ
item.description: [２６日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトのが全従業員の４分の１超に当たる約６万人の従業員に対し、希望退職を募集してい...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米マイクロソフト、約6万人対象に希望退職を募集　コスト抑制へ 3:12 配信

フランス・パリ近郊にある米マイクロソフトのオフィス。2025年3月撮影。REUTERS/Gonzalo Fuentes

[２６日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトのが全従業員の４分の１超に当たる約６万人の従業員に対し、希望退職を募集していると明らかにした。同社は巨額の人工知能（ＡＩ）投資資金を賄うため、コスト抑制に取り組んでいる。

事情に詳しい関係筋が匿名を条件に語ったところによると、対象となるのは「ＡＩエクスペリエンス」、ＡＩアシスタント「コパイロット」、財務、人事、ゲーム部門「Ｘｂｏｘ」などの従業員で、マーケティング、商業部門、セキュリティーなどの部門の従業員は対象外になるという。

マイクロソフトは、今回の募集は、カナダ、インド、英国、米国の対象チームに属する、レベル７０以下の対象従業員が利用できると説明した。

エイミー・コールマン最高人事責任者は従業員向けの文書で「この募集は、将来的に社外でのキャリアを検討している対象従業員に対し、支援を受けながら今すぐ転身するための新たな選択肢を提供するものだ。また、対象となる部門にとっては、変化するニーズに合わせて人員体制を調整するための新たな手段にもなる」と記した。

マイクロソフトは他のテクノロジー大手と同様、ＡＩ向けのデータセンターや半導体に数千億ドルを投じており、その莫大なコストに見合うだけのリターンが得られるかどうか、投資家の厳しい視線が注がれている。同社は２８日の市場引け後に第1・四半期決算を発表する予定で、２０２６暦年の設備投資額を１７５０億ドルと見込んでいる。

今回の件は、ニュースサイトのビジネス・インサイダーが最初に報じていた。

同社の株価は午後の取引で約１％上昇した。

item.title: Tata Motors' takeover bid for Iveco clears 80% acceptance threshold
item.description: India's Tata Motors' takeover bid for Italian truck maker Iveco has cleared the 80% acceptance threshold, reaching 87.8% on the last day of the offer, an Italian stock market filing showed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's Tata Motors' (TATM.NS) takeover bid for Italian truck maker Iveco (IVG.MI) has cleared the 80% acceptance threshold, reaching 87.8% on the last day of the offer, an Italian stock market filing showed on Monday. Tata now holds 89.42% of Iveco's common share capital based on provisional results, both companies said Final results will be communicated before market opening on October 29 The offer is set to be reopened during November 2-6, Iveco said The tender offer ending Monday ran from September 7 The offer price was raised to €14.40 per share, from €14.10 per share, on October 9 Tata Motors [USN:L8N3TR2BQ TEXT:"agreed last year"] to buy Iveco's commercial vehicle business in a deal valued at €3.8 billion

item.title: Average price of gasoline during Trump's term now exceeds Biden's, as midterms loom
item.description: Americans have paid more for their gasoline and diesel at the pump on average during President Donald Trump's second term than they did under his Democratic predecessor, Joe Biden, according to the AAA.
item.dc:creator: Georgina Mccartney
item.content:encoded: Americans have paid more for their gasoline and diesel at the pump on average during President Donald Trump's second term than they did under his Democratic predecessor, Joe Biden, according to the AAA. Surging fuel prices are a major thorn in Trump's side as [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"] loom and the Republican Party looks to defend narrow majorities in both legislative chambers on November 3. The price of a gallon of regular gasoline has averaged $3.472 since Trump took office almost two years ago, edging out the $3.471-per-gallon average for Biden's term, according to data from the AAA. Russia's war in Ukraine , now in its fifth year, as well as the US-Israeli war with Iran , almost in its ninth month, have both squeezed global crude and fuel supplies and forced emergency oil releases in the US and Europe. The war in Iran has spilled out across the Middle East, with much of the conflict centered around the Strait of Hormuz, through which around a fifth of global oil and gas supplies flowed before the war broke out in February. “Once this conflict comes to an end, gas prices will drop drastically... Thanks to the exceptional work of the US military, more oil is now flowing out of the Persian Gulf than before the Iran conflict began,” said White House spokeswoman Taylor Rogers. The seven-day moving average for Middle East oil exports including Hormuz flows and Gulf of Oman shipments as well as Red Sea shipments reached 24.6 million barrels per day in the week to October 18, according to Kpler, its highest level since the war broke out in late February, and surpassing pre-war levels. STICKY INFLATION Sticky inflation makes nominal price comparisons misleading, analysts said, with consumer expectations for inflation over the next year nudged up to 4.7% from 4.6% in September, a [USN:L1N4690PT TEXT:"survey"] showed last week. Twelve-month inflation expectations have surged from 3.4% in February before the US-Israeli war with Iran started. "Adjusting for inflation puts this into context as the value of the dollar continues to impact prices over the longer run. Americans are still not paying record amounts of their income on filling up their tanks," said Patrick De Haan, head of petroleum analysis at GasBuddy, on average fuel prices under Trump surpassing those under Biden. Trump's approval rating fell to a record low this month as Americans worried about high gasoline prices, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll published on October 19. Some 31% of Americans approve of Trump's performance in office, down a percentage point from two weeks earlier and the lowest level in either of his presidential terms, the four-day poll showed. Just 23% of adults polled nationwide approve of his handling of the economy. Prices for diesel, the fuel that powers the global economy from agriculture and heavy industry to shipping, have also surpassed Biden's national average under Trump, at $4.343 a gallon compared with $4.078 a gallon. US diesel hit a record high on September 22 at $6.523 a gallon.

By Makini Brice and Inti Landauro PARIS, Oct 26 (Reuters) – French student leaders said the government had offered a package of education proposals on Monday in response to weeks of street protests, but vowed to keep demonstrating as the measures had fallen short of their demands.

Emerging from a meeting with government officials, the students said the proposals included capping the size of some classes, loans for renovating schools and the replacement of a university admissions system they saw as unfair.

“Not all our demands were met. We’ll go on for as long as it takes,” Louis Letoublon, one of the representatives of high school students, said.

Show Full Article

There was no immediate confirmation of the education proposals from the government. A press conference to announce the details was delayed.

There were no immediate details on how much funding any such education package would require. The hands of President Emmanuel Macron’s minority government are tied by national debt approaching 120% of GDP and high new borrowing needs already making it difficult to agree a budget for next year.

The protests, initially triggered by student discontent, have shown little sign of easing after violence nine days ago engulfed dozens of cities, leading to fears the state had lost control of the streets.

The movement has since expanded, drawing in trade unions and “yellow vest” activists, known for their high-visibility jackets and mass demonstrations against economic pressures including high fuel costs.

Earlier, Macron acknowledged it was likely there would be more unrest this weekend ahead of a bigger nationwide day of protests set for November 5.

On a tour to survey the damage in Marseille and to thank emergency services after Saturday’s protests, he said he would keep security measures in place and work to move protests outside city centres.

The unrest and the sense among many French that authorities are struggling to keep the peace have further boosted the poll ratings of far-right candidate Marine Le Pen, already the frontrunner in next year’s presidential election.

An opinion poll published Sunday put her on 32%-33.5%, well ahead of her nearest rival, hard-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon on 17%. Surveys suggest she would easily defeat Melenchon in a run-off ballot, expected to be held in early May.

FAR-RIGHT GANGS CONFRONT FAR-LEFT ACTIVISTS

Interior Minister Laurent Nunez earlier said 1,435 people were arrested nationwide during demonstrations on Saturday and that police had also recorded a new phenomenon, with organised far-right gangs confronting far-left activists in several cities.

“We knew there had been calls from numerous identity-based and nationalist movements to come out, officially, to defend businesses,” he said. “In a number of cities, such as Nice and Montpellier, these groups arrived in organised formations, mainly to target the ultra-left movement.”

A selloff in French government bonds paused on Monday after the country’s sovereign debt was spared a ratings downgrade on Friday by rating agency Moody’s.

But business leaders said the unrest was continuing to inflict heavy economic damage despite a calmer weekend.

Alain Di Crescenzo, head of the CCI France network of chambers of commerce and industry, said many retailers had remained closed as a precaution after the violence of October 17, adding that sales had fallen by about 80%.

“We have shopkeepers who are tired and demoralised, and we are killing local commerce,” he told Radio Classique.

(Reporting by Sudip Kar-Gupta, Makini Brice and Inti Landauro; Writing by Mark John; Editing by Toby Chopra and Andrew Heavens)

item.title: Apple presenta un nuevo iPad mini más delgado, ligero y resistente al agua: precio y características
item.description: El dispositivo incorpora el chip A20 Pro, una pantalla más grande y resistencia al agua y al polvo. Los pedidos anticipados comienzan el miércoles y la venta al público arrancará el 6 de noviembre.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman, Chris Welch
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) presentó este lunes un iPad mini renovado con pantalla OLED, diseño resistente al agua y un chip más rápido, iniciando de esta manera una semana de lanzamientos de productos. Esta tableta, con un precio de US$699, cuenta con una pantalla OLED de 8,5 pulgadas que ofrece negros más profundos, blancos más brillantes y un contraste mejorado. Apple además aumentó el tamaño de la pantalla con respecto a las 8,3 pulgadas anteriores al reducir el grosor de los biseles que rodean el panel. El dispositivo rediseñado también incluye un nuevo sistema de audio denominado Acoustic Display , que ubica los altavoces debajo de la pantalla, lo que contribuye a que este sea el primer iPad con clasificación IP67 de resistencia al polvo y al agua. Ver más: ¿Vale la pena el iPhone Duo? Esto dicen los expertos sobre el primer teléfono plegable de Apple El nuevo iPad mini es un 14% más delgado y un 13% más ligero que el anterior modelo, y Apple ha reubicado la cámara frontal para que resulte más adecuada para las llamadas de FaceTime y las videoconferencias. En su interior, cuenta con el chip A20 Pro, una mejora respecto al procesador A17 Pro del anterior iPad mini, cuyo precio partía en US$599. Se ofrece con opciones de pantalla estándar y con nanotextura mate, así como con configuraciones de almacenamiento que van desde los 128 hasta los 512 gigabytes. Con la configuración máxima de almacenamiento, una pantalla mate grabada y conectividad móvil, la tableta puede llegar a costar hasta los US$1.249. Apple además ha mejorado el nuevo modelo con su chip de red N1, lo que incorpora Wi-Fi 7 y Bluetooth 6 al iPad mini. Los modelos con conexión móvil están equipados con el módem C2 de la compañía. El último iPad mini da comienzo a una serie de lanzamientos de productos de Apple previstos para finales de octubre. A finales de esta semana, la compañías tiene previsto presentar una nueva iMac y una MacBook Pro de 14 pulgadas con el chip M6, antes de cerrar la semana con su primer MacBook Pro con pantalla táctil. Los pedidos por adelantado del nuevo iPad mini comienzan este miércoles y saldrá a la venta el 6 de noviembre. El último modelo está disponible en los colores denominados midnight y starlight . Ver más: Apple se convierte en refugio de Wall Street ante los temores por el gasto en IA El chip A20 Pro del iPad mini se ofrece en dos versiones: los modelos de 128 y 256 gigabytes incluyen cinco núcleos de CPU, mientras que la configuración de gama alta cuenta con seis núcleos. Ambos utilizan siete núcleos gráficos. La variante de gama alta cuenta además con un Neural Engine dual de 16 núcleos para un procesamiento mejorado de la inteligencia artificial. Apple celebrará este miércoles un evento de presentación en Los Ángeles, donde los miembros de la prensa y los creadores de contenidos podrán interactuar con los nuevos dispositivos. Estas presentaciones ponen el broche final a un año repleto de lanzamientos de productos para Apple, incluido el del pasado viernes del iPhone Duo, su primer smartphone plegable. Bloomberg News informó por primera vez sobre el nuevo iPad mini en el 2025. La compañía además está trabajando en un nuevo iPad de gama baja, un iPad Air con pantalla OLED y un iPad Pro renovado para el primer semestre del próximo año. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Now home, Venezuela opposition leader Machado walks tightrope with supporters, Trump
item.description: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado, who returned on Sunday after nearly a year away, will walk a tightrope as she seeks the elections her supporters want without running afoul of a US-backed negotiation process between the interim government and other opposition groups.
item.dc:creator: Mayela Armas, Julia Symmes Cobb
item.content:encoded: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado, who returned on Sunday after nearly a year away, will walk a tightrope as she seeks the elections her supporters want without running afoul of a US-backed negotiation process between the interim government and other opposition groups. Machado's return to Venezuela after [USN:L1N45F02O TEXT:"several failed attempts"] risks [USN:L1N42Y0X4 TEXT:"straining her ties"] with US President Donald Trump's administration. Washington has said she has every right to be in Venezuela, but has praised acting President Delcy Rodriguez and supports a negotiation process between the Rodriguez government and opposition groups that do not include Machado's Vente Venezuela movement. The talks, which have continued this month, would remake the electoral council and top court ahead of eventual elections. Both bodies are staffed by ruling party loyalists and backed ousted President Nicolas Maduro in a disputed 2024 presidential election, despite tallies published by Machado's movement that showed her candidate had won. The US military captured Maduro in January. Machado supporters, tens of thousands of whom swarmed her caravan between Barquisimeto and Caracas on Sunday, waving flags, chanting her name and festooning her with rosaries, are [USN:L2N46B03Y TEXT:"eager for elections"] and call her the next president. She has said a presidential vote should happen in 2027. Machado's team did not respond to a request for comment. Asked whether Machado would participate in the negotiations, Rodriguez said she hopes the dialogue will lead those who called for sanctions against the country — a common ruling party critique leveled at Machado — to feel remorse. Rodriguez added that the talks offer a chance for all voices to be heard. “I hope both the dialogue and the program for democratic coexistence and peace can provide a space where all voices can be heard, where voices seeking the good of the country can be heard," the acting president said during a visit to a military hospital in Caracas, where she urged politicians to concentrate on serious issues and not put on a "show." Though Machado [USN:L4N3W51LU TEXT:"cultivated Trump as an ally"] for years, he said last month it was [USN:L1N44V0SA TEXT:"too soon to consider democratic elections."] On Sunday, Trump said he had been unaware of her return plans, though a person briefed on her movements disputed that. RISK OF SHORT CIRCUIT WITH WASHINGTON Machado's eagerness for a vote could "short-circuit" the relationship with the US and its three-phase stabilization, recovery and transition plan for Venezuela, said Ricardo Rios, head of Poder y Estrategia, a political risk consultancy. "The idea (at the negotiations) is to hold a regional election before a presidential election. She will probably push for electoral guarantees and for a presidential election to be held as soon as possible," Rios said. But much remains to be defined before voters cast ballots. “What guarantees does the ruling sector have to leave power (if it is defeated)?" Rios asked. "That still needs to be defined in order to make this viable, because otherwise, no matter how popular she is, it complicates matters." US AND EU URGE DIALOGUE Machado's safe return was a direct outcome of the negotiations, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, a longtime champion of Machado, said on Sunday, adding he expects all political actors to support the talks. Venezuela's electoral infrastructure was designed to rig elections and so must be quickly replaced before a valid election can be held, he told reporters on Monday. He did not provide an estimated date for elections. "I think we're making real progress in that regard," Rubio said. "But if anybody tries to derail that process, they're doing a great harm to Venezuela." The EU echoed that sentiment, saying on Monday authorities and all political actors should advance "an inclusive, Venezuelan-led dialogue towards free and fair elections." The negotiations will lead to a top court being in place by the end of this year and a new electoral council shortly thereafter, a senior US State Department official said earlier. "The reception (Machado) got yesterday will only reinforce the tendency to demand instant results," said Phil Gunson, senior analyst for the Andes region at the International Crisis Group think tank. "Not only might that provoke a reaction from government hardliners, but it could — if successful — produce a political rupture instead of a peaceful transition, with inadequate post-electoral guarantees and a potentially ungovernable country." The opposition included in the talks, led by Dinorah Figuera, a lawmaker elected in 2015 to the last Venezuelan legislative body recognized by the US, said Machado's return was a significant step in the US plan. “Her role is also tied to how she interprets the signals from the United States, which has called for reconstruction and reconciliation. She has to be an ally in the negotiations," said Oswaldo Ramirez, managing director of ORC Consultores. "Rubio sent a clear message," he added. “I don’t see her trying to torpedo the negotiations. She can’t stray outside the lines.”

item.title: Soja, café e açúcar caem nas bolsas globais com alta do dólar após eleição no Brasil
item.description: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago chegaram a cair mais de 2% nesta segunda-feira, enquanto o açúcar e o café também despencaram, pressionados pela desvalorização da moeda brasileira em relação ao dólar, após os resultados das eleições no Brasil.
item.dc:creator: P.J. Huffstutter, May Angel
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago chegaram a cair mais de 2% nesta segunda-feira, enquanto o açúcar e o café também despencaram, pressionados pela desvalorização da moeda brasileira em relação ao dólar, após os resultados das eleições no Brasil. O Brasil é o maior produtor de soja, café e açúcar, enquanto o dólar mais forte frente ao real torna os produtos mais acessíveis para compradores no exterior. A moeda norte-americana mais valorizada também impulsiona vendas de exportadores. O real brasileiro enfraqueceu perto de 12% em relação ao dólar norte-americano no mercado à vista, quando as negociações no Brasil tiveram início nesta segunda-feira, e a bolsa de valores do país suspendeu as negociações por meio de um mecanismo de segurança de interrupção automática, na esteira da reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. O mercado reverteu o otimismo que se instalou entre os investidores quando o rival de direita, Flávio Bolsonaro, liderou o primeiro turno das eleições no início do mês. Operadores afirmaram que a surpreendente reviravolta foi particularmente negativa para os futuros de soja dos EUA, concorrentes do Brasil neste mercado. "Certamente a eleição foi uma surpresa, e isso está ligado à desvalorização da moeda e, consequentemente, à queda nos preços da soja", disse Jack Scoville, vice-presidente e analista de mercado do The Price Futures Group, em Chicago. "A magnitude do movimento nos preços da soja decorre disso e também exerceu alguma pressão indireta sobre o milho." O contrato novembro da soja fechou em baixa de 15,25 centavos, cotado a US$12,4125 por bushel. Os preços da soja também foram pressionados pela chegada da colheita recorde dos EUA ao mercado. Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto negociados na bolsa ICE , considerados uma referência global de preços, recuaram 5,6%, para fechar a 19,10 centavos de dólar por libra-peso. Já os contratos futuros de café arábica na ICE caíram 2,1%, para US$3,0095 por libra-peso, distanciando-se da máxima de seis semanas registrada na quarta-feira, de US$3,1820. O açúcar refinado terminou em queda de 3,6% para US$515,40 a tonelada, enquanto o café robusta perdeu 1,3% para US$3.201 a tonelada. Já o milho negociado em Chicago terminou com leve baixa de 1 centavo, a US$4,55 o bushel, pressionado pelo avanço da colheita nos EUA. O trigo caiu 9 centavos, para US$6,16 o bushel, em meio a uma nova proposta de reabertura segura das exportações de grãos pelo Mar Negro, onde terminais estão limitados por conta da guerra entre Ucrânia e Rússia. (Por P.J. Huffstutter, May Angel e Marcelo Teixeira)

item.title: Machete-wielding mob attack health workers responding to Ebola in Congo
item.description: Angry youths armed with machetes attacked two community health workers raising awareness about the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, killing one and wounding the other, according to officials and a memo seen by Reuters on Monday, in the latest in a series of attacks fueled by misinformation.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Angry youths armed with machetes attacked two community health workers raising awareness about the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, killing one and wounding the other, according to officials and a memo seen by Reuters on Monday, in the latest in a series of attacks fueled by misinformation. The worker who was killed was an experienced nurse who had worked at the general hospital in the town of Bafwasende in Tshopo province, and was recently tasked with helping to raise awareness about the deadly virus in the local community, where he was a well-known figure, a local official and the memo said. "We are shocked at how the population turned against this nurse. It is impossible to believe that he was mistaken for a stranger," a local health official told Reuters. The attack took place on Friday afternoon, when the nurse and a colleague, a teacher also working on community outreach, stopped to check on a lot of land. A group of people building a home next door began to accuse them of spreading the disease by contaminating water. "Here are the people that are spreading the Ebola virus through people's toilets and rivers!" they shouted, according to the memo shared by a health official. The angry group was joined by youths wielding machetes and batons, who attacked the pair. The nurse died on the spot before the hospital's emergency services could reach them, the memo said, while the teacher survived. MISINFORMATION FUELING ATTACK Tshopo is among eight provinces in Congo that are battling a fast-spreading outbreak of the Bundibugyo species of the Ebola virus. Congo's public health institute on Friday reported 9,964 total confirmed cases with around a 48.6% fatality rate since the outbreak was declared in May. Attacks on [USN:L8N44026Z TEXT:"health workers"] have [USN:L8N43I0HO TEXT:"targeted hospitals"], vehicles and staff involved in the Ebola response, underscoring the challenge of building trust among the population. The local official said health workers in Bafwasende, where the latest attack took place, are sheltering at the general hospital under police guard, too afraid to go home, while the army also briefly deployed to the area. "None of the nurses have slept at their homes because they fear for their security," the official added. Only days earlier, an angry mob attacked another community worker raising awareness about Ebola, and set his house on fire, the memo said. Reuters previously reported on how [USN:L1N41K0Z7 TEXT:"the rapid spread of health misinformation"] posed a threat to healthcare workers in eastern Congo even before Ebola began to spread, with multiple health workers killed in Tshopo after they were accused of spreading an imaginary disease that caused male genitals to atrophy. "The killing of a nurse yesterday in Bafwasende is a loss to the Ebola response and an even greater loss to patients," Julien Harneis, the senior United Nations Ebola coordinator, said in a post on X on Sunday.

item.title: ＡＩ銘柄上昇、アンソロピックがＩＰＯ申請書類公開 ナスダック約320ポイント高
item.description: [２６日 ロイター] - ２６日の米国株式市場で、ＡＩ（人工知能）のインフラ投資が債務に依存しているとの警戒感が強まる...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ銘柄上昇、アンソロピックがＩＰＯ申請書類公開　ナスダック約320ポイント高 1:37 配信

米ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で10月26日撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

[２６日 ロイター] - ２６日の米国株式市場で、ＡＩ（人工知能）のインフラ投資が債務に依存しているとの警戒感が強まる中、同関連株が上昇した。ＡＩ開発のアンソロピックが米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類を公開したことが材料となった。

時価総額世界一の半導体大手エヌビディアの株価は３％近く上昇。マイクロソフトとアマゾンも、それぞれ１％近く上げた。

ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総合は一時、約３２０ポイント上昇。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は３％超上昇した。

アナリストらは、アンソロピックのような巨大ＡＩ専業企業が上場に成功すれば、半導体メーカーや関連インフラ企業など、急成長している同業界の一角に対する市場の評価の仕方が変わる可能性があると指摘している。また、投資家がＡＩ関連の新たな投資先を組み入れようとポートフォリオの再配分を進めれば、一部の大手テクノロジー企業から資金が流出する可能性もある。

オールスプリング・グローバル・インベストメンツのマイケル・スミス氏は「結局のところ、現在ＡＩに投資するということは、話題を集める有名銘柄の先にある機会を探すことだ」と指摘。「現在、ＡＩ分野における魅力的な投資機会は、拡大するインフラ上の懸念を効率的かつ迅速に解決できる中小企業にあるかもしれない」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ルノー、ＥＶ新会社ＩＰＯ中止は「災い転じて福」か コラム：ビットコインＥＴＦ初承認、実用化拡大はなお遠い アングル：来年のＩＰＯ回復に期待、米利下げ観測が追い風 アングル：中国ユニツリー、上場後に株価急落　バブルやＩＰＯ制度に懸念 焦点：ＳＨＥＩＮの香港上場、ＥＳＧ問題がなお影　投資家の懸念根強く 最終更新: 10/27(火) 1:37 ロイター

item.title: Serbia's student movement toppled a political giant. Can it now govern the country?
item.description: Who will emerge from this leaderless movement as prime minister, what exactly will their policies be, and can a bunch of political unknowns with no previous affiliation stick together to shore up the economy, root out graft and juggle complex international relations?
item.dc:creator: Edward Mcallister, Aleksandar Vasovic
item.content:encoded: By unseating longtime leader Aleksandar Vucic in Sunday's election, Serbia's student protest movement did what demonstrators in other European capitals can only dream of. Now, though, comes the gritty business of governing - something neither the students nor their handpicked candidates have any experience of. Tens of thousands of people took to the streets across the country [USN:L6N46B0A6 TEXT:"to celebrate"] when Vucic conceded defeat late on Sunday in a historic poll that capped two years of peaceful anti-government protests. But as the jubilant crowd lit flares and fireworks, sang and danced, questions lingered: who will emerge from this leaderless movement as prime minister, what exactly will their policies be, and can a bunch of political unknowns with no previous affiliation stick together to shore up the economy, root out graft and juggle complex international relations? The answers will determine the political stability of Serbia, the largest economy in the Western Balkans, and its relations with China, [USN:L6N46C0NO TEXT:"Russia,"] and its largest trading partner, the European Union. The students' victory "is likely to trigger broad institutional and policy changes centred on anti-corruption, the rule of law, and better public services. However, bureaucratic resistance to reforms and the movement’s limited governing experience could make the transition challenging," Teneo Global Research said in a report on Monday. WINNERS, BUT CAN THEY STICK TOGETHER? The protest movement began after 16 people died when a railway station canopy collapsed in the northern city of Novi Sad in 2024 and the student-led demonstrations called for accountability and an end to corruption. Despite not having a figurehead, the students won [USN:L8N4650K6 TEXT:"widespread support,"] before choosing 250 academics, lawyers, doctors, actors, farmers and musicians to represent them in the election. The movement and some of the top candidates on its list have given [USN:L6N46C0IX TEXT:"some idea of what it stands for,"] promising a domestic anti-corruption program centred on institutional overhauls. It does not recognise Kosovo, Serbia's former southern province which declared independence in 2008, but wants to hold a referendum on Serbia's accession to the EU, with which relations have frayed in recent years. Prominent figures include the head of the students' candidate list, cardiologist Ilija Srdanovic, former central bank governor Dejan Soskic and Radomir Sajcic, a professor at Belgrade University, who spoke on behalf of the students following their victory. But there is no certainty that any of them will hold a ministerial post, and it remains to be seen whether the candidates can form a cohesive government that can agree on policy long enough to use their comfortable parliamentary majority to enact change. "(The student movement created) such a shift in Serbia's culture; we will just have to see if it lasts," said Katarina Popovic, also a professor at the University of Belgrade. "We just hope that there are big goals that can keep them together long enough to deconstruct the system." REFORMING PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS Under Serbia's constitution, the students' candidates have 90 days to form a government once parliament is convened after the announcement of final results by the state election commission. Time matters, especially with a budget to pass before year-end amid growing public and private debt levels, while any attempt to end corruption will require an overhaul of the police and intelligence services and [USN:L6N3Z90I6 TEXT:"judicial reform"]. State institutions require "detoxification" after 14 years of Vucic, said Bozo Prelevic, a Belgrade-based lawyer and former co-minister of the interior. Prelevic warned that Vucic's Serbian Progressive Party (SNS), will pose a strong opposition, and that the new government would have to fight its corner. Vucic and the SNS repeatedly denied accusations of repression and corruption. INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS In Russia, Serbia's traditional ally and principal supplier of natural gas, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov praised Vucic, but stopped short of congratulating the students. "We respect Russia both as a great power and as our historically important partner and, in many cases, protector," Student List representative Jovo Bakic, a sociologist and a university lecturer, told Russia’s RT Balkan TV, adding that there would be no change in Serbia's foreign policy towards Russia, including not introducing sanctions against Moscow. Also closely watching is Ukraine, which has been an indirect beneficiary of Serbian weapons in its fight to repel Russia's four-year-long invasion. European officials [USN:L6N46C0NS TEXT:"congratulated the students"] and said they stood ready to help the country in its fight against corruption. "I am sure (the Student List) will find a way, just as they have so far, to choose someone capable of governing - someone who will have the privilege, but also the immense responsibility, to lead Serbia through these reforms," said Savo Manojlovic of the student-friendly Move-Change movement.

item.title: エジプト議会、サウジ軍事支援承認 対フーシ派に直接関与の可能性
item.description: [カイロ ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カイロ　２６日　ロイター] - エジプト議会は２６日、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の攻撃を受けているサウジアラビアの自衛を支援するため、シシ大統領に「あらゆる必要な措置」を講じる権限を認めた。これにより、サウジとフーシ派の紛争にエジプトが直接的に関与する可能性が高まった。

シシ大統領は、サウジから支援要請があった場合にエジプト軍による支援を認めるよう議会に求めていた。ロイターが議会関係者から入手した議会声明によると、出席議員の少なくとも３分の２以上が賛成した。

サウジはエジプトにとって主要な政治・財政支援国で、これまでに数十億ドル規模の支援やエネルギー供給などを実施。エジプトはこれまでも、イランやイランが支援する勢力による湾岸諸国への攻撃をたびたび非難してきた。ただ、サウジ、トルコ、パキスタンの８月に締結した相互防衛協定「メッカ共同防衛協定」には参加しておらず、直接的な軍事行動にも公には加わっていない。

メッカ共同防衛協定を締結したサウジア、トルコ、パキスタンの高官はこの日、イランの首都テヘランでイラン指導部との会合を開いている。

item.title: Anthropic discloses month-long training pause, AI security breaches in IPO filing
item.description: Anthropic paused training of its next-generation flagship AI model for more than a month over security concerns, while four of its AI agents accessed live external computer systems during testing, its initial public offering filing showed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic paused training of its next-generation flagship AI model for more than a month over security concerns, while four of its AI agents accessed live external computer systems during testing, its [USN:L3N46C10M TEXT:"initial public offering filing"] showed on Monday. The Claude maker said in the filing's risk factors section that it had delayed pre-training of a new "frontier" base model to strengthen safeguards against the theft of model weights and intellectual property. The disclosure highlights the safety challenges facing developers of increasingly powerful AI models, some of whose creators have warned the technology could eventually escape human control. Rival OpenAI also paused some training earlier this year over safety concerns after its models hacked Hugging Face. The incidents illustrate how unexpected safety failures could disrupt development and deployment of models central to Anthropic's growth as it prepares for a widely anticipated stock market debut. Anthropic warned that training pauses could delay revenue and leave it trailing competitors. The company devoted about 94 pages to risk factors, more than in its confidential filing seen by Reuters. SANDBOX ESCAPE The filing also detailed previously undisclosed [USN:L1N45S0TG TEXT:"safety evaluation"] failures in which four AI models escaped their testing environments and accessed real-world computer systems, with sessions lasting between 10 and 34 hours. Anthropic said an error during cybersecurity tests with a third-party partner left the testing environment connected to the internet despite instructions that web access be disabled. In one instance, an early version of the model continued pursuing an impossible evaluation task, discovered a stored password and used it to gain administrator access to a third party's system. It then obtained additional credentials, changed system settings and accessed an individual's personal data. The filing did not identify the external parties involved. Anthropic said it notified all affected parties and found no evidence that the models had sought to evade human oversight or coordinate with each other. It subsequently suspended certain pre-release cybersecurity evaluations and paused higher-risk reinforcement learning environments. Separately, the company said on Sunday that Claude had [USN:L2N46B085 TEXT:"bypassed a paywall"] and accessed publicly available aggregate voter counts from the US state of Georgia without human authorization.

item.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to around 60,000 employees to contain costs
item.description: Microsoft said on Monday it is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, or more than a quarter of its global workforce, as the technology giant looks to contain costs and help fund its massive AI investments.
item.dc:creator: Jaspreet Singh
item.content:encoded: Microsoft (MSFT.O) said on Monday it is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, or more than a quarter of its global workforce, as the technology giant looks to contain costs and help fund its massive AI investments. Staffers across the Windows maker would be eligible for the offers, including those working in AI experiences, Copilot, finance, human resources, Xbox and Windows + Devices, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters, requesting anonymity as the matter was private. Units such as marketing, commercial business and security will be excluded, the source added. "This offer gives eligible employees who may be considering a future outside the company a new choice to make that transition now with support. It also gives participating organizations another way to adapt their workforce to changing needs," Chief People Officer Amy Coleman said in a staff memo. Like other tech giants, Microsoft is spending hundreds of billions of dollars on AI data centers and chips, drawing scrutiny from investors over whether the returns will justify the staggering cost. The company, slated to report first-quarter results after markets close on Wednesday, has forecast $175 billion in capital expenditures for the 2026 calendar year. Microsoft had 223,000 full-time employees globally as of June 30, 2026, according to its annual filing. Shares of Microsoft, which had risen about 10% this year, were up about 1% on Monday. The development was first reported by Business Insider. The company earlier this year offered voluntary buyouts to about 7% of its US workforce, or about 9,000 employees. In July, Microsoft [USN:L4N4380XC TEXT:"announced it would cut 4,800 jobs"], or about 2.1% of its global workforce, overhauling its Xbox gaming business and divesting up to five studios as it looks to boost returns after years of heavy investment in the division. "This offer will be available to eligible employees in participating teams in Canada, India, the United Kingdom and the United States at level 70 and below," Microsoft said on Monday. The company said it was a time-limited, voluntary program and built on insights gained from a previous voluntary retirement program. The eligible employees will receive details within the next few hours, it added.

Oct 26 (Reuters) – Slovakia will continue to pursue its national interests and develop cooperation with Russia in areas not affected by sanctions, Slovak Foreign Minister Juraj Blanar said on Monday after talks in Moscow with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov.

Blanar was in Moscow as Slovakia aimed to discuss Russian energy supplies while resuming a cooperation process suspended after Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

• The restart of consultations follows repeated trips to Moscow by Prime Minister Robert Fico, whose views stand out in the 27-member EU since the defeat of pro-Russian Hungarian leader Viktor Orban in an April election

Show Full Article

• Energy was a main topic of the renewed intergovernmental commission that held talks on Monday, the Slovak Foreign Ministry said, adding that Blanar was informed that Russia remained ready to fulfil agreed contracts

• Slovakia buys Russian oil and gas but is meant to stop the gas purchases by late 2027 under an EU plan to deprive Russia of financial resources that fund its war in Ukraine

• “The Russian Federation is difficult to replace for the stability of energy supplies not only for Slovakia, but also for global energy trade, which is evident now amid the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz,” Blanar said

• “Slovakia is a member of the European Union and NATO and we respect the rules that bind us, but within those we seek opportunities for cooperation in the interest of Slovakia’s national interests,” he added

(Reporting by Jason Hovet in Prague; Editing by Xevi Fontdegloria)

item.title: Colombia lanza bonos globales en dólares por 5.200 millones de dólares: IFR
item.description: El Gobierno de Colombia lanzó el lunes bonos en dólares a cinco, 10 y 30 años por un total de 5.200 millones de dólares, según un reporte de IFR, un servicio de información financiera de LSEG.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno de Colombia lanzó el lunes bonos en dólares a cinco, 10 y 30 años por un total de 5.200 millones de dólares, según un reporte de IFR, un servicio de información financiera de LSEG. Las emisiones tienen como propósito financiar el presupuesto de gastos del país sudamericano, pero no se informó inmediatamente si se usarán para cubrir necesidades de este año o para 2027. La oferta considera un bono al 2032 por 2.200 millones de dólares, uno al 2037 por 2.000 millones y otro al 2056 por 1.000 millones, agregó el artículo. IFR reportó que los bonos a 5 años se ofrecieron con una tasa de 7,05%, los a 10 años con un 7,65% y los a 30 años entre un 8,15%, todos en el extremo inferior de las guías iniciales. Los agentes colocadores de la operación son BBVA, Itaú y JP Morgan. Colombia ya había finalizado sus necesidades de financiamiento de este año vía bonos internacionales, pero la semana pasada anunció un recorte de 13,8 billones de pesos (4.326 millones de dólares) en el presupuesto, inferior a los 21,9 billones de pesos que pretendía bajar, lo que supondría necesidad de más recursos. El presupuesto de 2027 propone colocaciones de deuda pública interna por 150,9 billones de pesos y endeudamiento externo por unos 26.101 millones de dólares vía emisiones en el mercado internacional de capitales y préstamos con los bancos de desarrollo multilaterales y bilaterales. El presidente Abelardo de La Espriella anunció que en los próximos días enviará al Congreso la denominada “Ley de Rescate Económico”, una iniciativa con la que el Gobierno busca enfrentar los desequilibrios fiscales del próximo año.

item.title: Merck drug extends survival in endometrial cancer trial, wins US priority review
item.description: The US health regulator has accepted Merck's experimental targeted drug for a priority review based on data from a late-stage trial where it extended survival in women with an advanced form of endometrial cancer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US health regulator has accepted Merck's (MRK.N) experimental targeted drug for a priority review based on data from a late-stage trial where it extended survival in women with an advanced form of endometrial cancer. The drug, sacituzumab tirumotecan, also known as sac-TMT, delivers a cancer-killing payload to cells that carry a protein called TROP2, which is common in endometrial tumors. The trial enrolled 776 patients whose cancer had returned or progressed after earlier treatment. Patients were randomly assigned to sac-TMT or to a chemotherapy their doctor chose, either doxorubicin or paclitaxel. Results showed sac-TMT reduced the risk of death by 32%, with patients living a median of 19 months compared with 12.1 months on standard chemotherapy. The treatment also reduced the risk of cancer progression or death by 41%, with patients remaining progression-free for a median of 7.2 months compared with 3.9 months on chemotherapy. In addition, about 35% of sac-TMT patients saw their tumors shrink, compared with 17% on chemotherapy. A regulatory decision is expected by June 2027, Merck said. The trial data was presented at the ESMO medical congress. "Based on discussions with the FDA, the company is hopeful for an approval before the PDUFA date to bring sac-TMT to patients as quickly as possible," said Dean Y. Li, president, Merck Research Laboratories. Severe treatment-related side effects were more frequent with sac-TMT, affecting about 54% of patients compared with 41% on chemotherapy. About 3% of patients stopped treatment due to side effects. About 68,000 cases of endometrial cancer are expected to be diagnosed in the United States in 2026, with over 14,000 deaths, according to the American Cancer Society. Jefferies analysts project peak sales of roughly $900 million in endometrial cancer for the drug and $9 billion across all potential indications. Merck is developing the drug with Chinese biotech firm Kelun-Biotech (6990.HK) , which discovered the therapy.

FAST

Oct 26 : AI-linked stocks rose on Monday after Anthropic revealed the paperwork for its initial public offering, against the backdrop of growing investor unease over debt-fueled spending on infrastructure for the new technology. Shares of Nvidia, the world's most valuable company, added nearly 3 per cent. Microsoft and Amazon gained nearly 1 per cent each. A successful flotation by a pure-play AI giant such as Anthropic could reshape how markets value parts of the booming industry, including chipmakers and related infrastructure companies, analysts have said. It could also divert capital from some tech heavyweights as investors make room in their portfolios for a new way to bet on the technology.

The industry's web of relationships adds another wrinkle, as some of the biggest technology companies are investors in both Anthropic and its chief rival, OpenAI. Among other AI stocks, battered shares of neoclouds CoreWeave and Nebius Group rose 5.7 per cent and 2.3 per cent, respectively, after the filing, reversing earlier losses following SpaceX CEO Elon Musk's comments. Data center operators Applied Digital and IREN gained 1 per cent and 3 per cent, respectively. Memory chipmaker Micron rose 3 per cent, and data-storage firms Sandisk, Western Digital and Seagate added about 2.5 per cent each. AMD and Broadcom gained 2.5 per cent and 3 per cent, respectively. Zoom Communications, an early investor in Anthropic, rose 1.5 per cent. The broader Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was up over 3 per cent. Focus now shifts to a potential IPO from OpenAI. But while the stakes are high, the long-term impact of the IPOs on the AI trade remains uncertain. "Ultimately, investing in AI today involves searching for opportunity beyond the headline names," said Michael Smith, head of the growth equity team at Allspring Global Investments. "Today, attractive investment opportunities in AI may be in small and medium-sized firms that can efficiently and quickly solve growing infrastructure concerns."

item.title: Rendimiento de bonos Tesoro EEUU a 10 años cotiza estable, a la espera de la Fed
item.description: El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años cotizó estable el lunes, mientras el mercado espera los resultados de las principales empresas de inteligencia artificial (IA) esta semana y antes de la reunión de la Reserva Federal, que se prevé que haga una pausa en sus alzas de las tasas de interés.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años cotizó estable el lunes, mientras el mercado espera los resultados de las principales empresas de inteligencia artificial (IA) esta semana y antes de la reunión de la Reserva Federal, que se prevé que haga una pausa en sus alzas de las tasas de interés. La presentación el lunes por parte de la empresa de IA Anthropic de la documentación para su oferta pública inicial (OPI) impulsó las acciones, y la IA seguirá siendo el centro de atención con las publicaciones de resultados de Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) y Amazon.com (AMZN.O) durante la semana. Los rendimientos de los bonos a 10 años se mantuvo en menos del 5%. El jueves pasado, el bono de referencia había anotado su mayor caída diaria de casi cuatro años, en un contexto de desplome las bolsas provocada por el temor sobre la sostenibilidad de la demanda de IA. "La semana pasada hubo mucha volatilidad", dijo Jim Barnes, director de renta fija de Bryn Mawr Trust. Los inversores quieren escuchar lo que digan esta semana las empresas relacionadas con la IA para hacerse una idea del gasto futuro, pero también de las perspectivas económicas generales, añadió. "Esto está empezando a influir en las expectativas de los inversores respecto a los rendimientos de los bonos en el futuro", añadió. Los inversores también estarán pendientes de la Fed, de la que se espera que mantenga las tasas de interés sin cambios cuando anuncie su decisión de política monetaria el miércoles. Las expectativas del mercado de un alza de tasas han bajado recientemente, en la medida en que los rendimientos se han moderado y los datos económicos han sido dispares. Los futuros sobre tasas de interés descontaban el lunes una probabilidad del 90% de que se mantengan las tasas sin cambios en la reunión de la Fed de esta semana, según CME FedWatch. El rendimiento del bono del Tesoro a 10 años de referencia cotizaba casi sin cambios en 4,988%, mientras que el de 30 años perdía 1,5 puntos básicos, al 5,3%. El retorno a dos años , que suele evolucionar en consonancia con las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés de la Fed, caía 1,5 puntos básicos, al 4,714%. Una parte de la curva de rendimientos que mide la diferencia entre los rendimientos de los bonos a 2 y a 10 años , y que se considera un indicador de las expectativas económicas, se situó en 27,2 puntos básicos positivos. El diferencial se redujo a un mínimo de casi un mes.

item.title: アウディＣＥＯの米選挙集会参加に批判、社内規範違反と労組反発
item.description:
Rachel More Christina Amann
[ベルリン ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Rachel More　Christina Amann

[ベルリン　２６日　ロイター] - ドイツの自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）傘下のアウディのデルナー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が１１月３日に控える米中間選挙の激戦州である南部ジョージア州で開かれた集会にトランプ米大統領と共に参加したことを受け、労働組合のトップは２６日、社内規範に違反しているとして批判した。

２４日の集会では、アウディによる４０億ドル規模の工場建設計画が発表された。自動車関税措置の影響を避けるため、年間２０万台のスポーツタイプ多目的車（ＳＵＶ）を生産する予定。これに対し、ドイツ最大の産業別労働組合ＩＧメタル会長でＶＷ監査役会に属するベンナー氏は「選挙期間中の政治的中立を求める自社規則に著しく違反している」と指摘した。計画には労働者代表を含むＶＷ監査役会の承認が必要となる。

関係者によると、アウディの経営陣は行動規範に対する例外を承認しており、別の労働組合関係者は反対しなかったものの懸念を表明したという。

トランプ氏はこれまでに極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」への支持を表明。ドイツの政財界の間では懸念が広がっている。ＶＷの第２の株主であるニーダーザクセン州のリース首相は、「選挙集会はこれほどの投資を発表するのにふさわしい場所ではない」とし、デルナー氏が政治的なショーの一環となったことは不適切だとの見方を示した。ＶＷグループのドイツ内の生産拠点は、コスト削減圧力を受け、人員削減などを進めている。

デルナー氏を「ミニ・イーロン・マスク」と称し、政治的言動で物議を醸した米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラのＣＥＯになぞらえる指摘もある。

item.title: Activos brasileños se hunden tras reelección de Lula, monedas cierran con ganancias
item.description: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, mientras que los activos brasileños se hundieron tras la reelección del presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula Da Silva, en el inicio de una semana marcada por la reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, mientras que los activos brasileños se hundieron tras la reelección del presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula Da Silva, en el inicio de una semana marcada por la reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos. * Lula logró el domingo un cuarto mandato, algo sin precedentes en Brasil, en un resultado que supuso la primera vez que un candidato que quedó por detrás en la primera vuelta se proclamó vencedor en el balotaje. * El real brasileño se depreció un 8,36%, a 5,4066 unidades por dólar, tras hundirse más temprano poco más de un 12%, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo se desplomó un 13,43%, su mayor caída diaria desde marzo de 2020. * La bolsa brasileña detuvo sus operaciones durante 30 minutos después de que el Bovespa cayera un 10% respecto a su cierre anterior, lo que activó el mecanismo de seguridad del mercado, informó en un comunicado B3, el operador bursátil. * Los mercados prevén que la Fed dejará sin cambios las tasas de interés tras su reunión de política monetaria que concluirá el miércoles, pero ven como altamente probable un incremento en diciembre. * El índice dólar , que compara a la divisa ante una canasta de seis importantes monedas, avanzaba poco más de un 0,3%. * El peso mexicano cotizaba al cierre en 18,5588 unidades por dólar, con un alza del 0,49% tras revertir pérdidas de primera hora. * La posibilidad de que las principales economías suban las tasas reduciría la ventaja de los rendimientos que ofrece México frente al exterior, restando atractivo a las operaciones de carry trade que durante años han canalizado flujos hacia activos locales y respaldaron al peso. * El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, caía un 0,58%, a 69.475,67 puntos, en contraste con los avances de Wall Street, mientras los inversionistas seguían atentos a la temporada de resultados corporativos del tercer trimestre. * En Argentina, el peso mayorista se depreció un 0,75% a 1.541 por dólar, tras tocar un mínimo histórico intradiario de 1.542 unidades para la venta, y los bonos en la ronda extrabursátil retrocedieron en promedio un 0,6%. * El banco central (BCRA) no contabilizó intervención cambiaria, como se preveía, ante reservas provisorias en 50.481 millones de dólares. * El índice accionario MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) cayó un 2,91% al cierre, luego de derrumbarse más del 6% en los primeros compases de la rueda, contagiado por la bolsa de Brasil. * El peso chileno , subió un ligero 0,07%, a 992,90/993,20 unidades por dólar. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , retrocedió un 1,59%, a 10.575,59 unidades. * El peso colombiano borró pérdidas iniciales y terminó con alza de un 0,48% a 3.130 unidades por dólar, en su tercera sesión de ganancias, mientras que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) caía un 1,87% a 2.492,27 puntos cerca del cierre a la espera de la reunión de política monetaria del banco central de Colombia. * Según un sondeo de Reuters, el Banco Central colombiano incrementaría su tasa de interés de referencia en su reunión del viernes, en 25 puntos base a un 12,50%, para atajar las crecientes expectativas inflacionarias. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreció un 0,17% a3,4420/3,4430 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) operaba estable en 1.513,28 puntos.

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 26 : Unconventional AI, the US hardware startup that launched less than a year ago with a $4.5 billion valuation, said on Monday that it is buying Israeli chip startup NeuReality for an undisclosed sum in a cash-and-stock deal. Unconventional AI raised $475 million in December and is led by Naveen Rao, who previously sold chip startup Nervana to Intel for more than $400 million and AI software startup MosaicML to Databricks for $1.3 billion. It is backed by prominent Silicon Valley venture firms Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia, along with Amazon.com founder Jeff Bezos, among others. Mountain View, California-based Unconventional AI's goal is to develop AI chips that are 1,000 times more energy efficient than current offerings by using concepts from biological systems. The company is focusing on what Rao calls a "dynamical systems" approach, in which simple computing elements interact with simple rules and evolve over time to reach a result, rather than following programmed step-by-step logic as conventional computing chips do. In an interview, Rao said that when Unconventional AI raised its $475 million war chest of cash, the company expected to take three years in research and development and take five years to develop a product.

But by using AI tools to speed its work, Unconventional AI already has developed its first test chip and is nearing completion of its second, prompting the company to look for an engineering team with experience delivering finished products, Rao said. Founded in 2019 by Moshe Tanach, formerly of Marvell Technology and Intel, Tzvika Shmueli and Yossi Kasus, NeuReality had already developed several advanced AI chips. "Things have gone a lot faster than anticipated," Rao told Reuters. "We need people who can go execute and build products and scale them. We built up the research bones and now we've got to build up the production bones."  Rao, who served on NeuReality's board, said about 40 people will join Unconventional AI as part of the deal, and that Unconventional AI will maintain a presence in Israel.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ネオクラウド関連株下落、マスク氏が業界の「再編・破綻」予測
item.description: [２６日 ロイター] - ２６日の米国株式市場で、人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスに特化した「ネオクラウド」企業の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ネオクラウド関連株下落、マスク氏が業界の「再編・破綻」予測 10/26 23:46 配信

ネオクラウド企業コアウィーブのロゴ。７月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２６日 ロイター] - ２６日の米国株式市場で、人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスに特化した「ネオクラウド」企業の株価が下落した。宇宙企業スペースＸのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が、同業界は大幅な再編や倒産に直面する可能性があると発言したことを受け、ＡＩインフラ投資と収益創出の間に広がる格差への懸念が強まった。

午前の取引で一時、ネオクラウド企業のコアウィーブは１．６％下落。ネビウス・グループは４％、アプライド・デジタルは２％、それぞれ下落した。

マスク氏は２５日、債務市場では「ＡＩデータセンター以外から多額の収入を得ていない企業は、資金調達の道をほぼ完全に閉ざされている」と指摘。このため、「ネオクラウド」企業の間で大規模な再編や経営破綻が起きると予測した上で、スペースＸがネオクラウド企業を買収することはないとし、「無意味だ」と述べた。

グレートヒル・キャピタル会長のトーマス・ヘイズ氏は「マスク氏は正しい。これらのプロジェクトを今後進めるための資金を賄うには、別の収益・利益源が必要になるだろう。資本コストが高すぎて魅力的なリターンを得ることは難しい」と語った。

コアウィーブの広報担当者はロイターへの電子メールで、同社は「差別化された技術」といった強みに支えられ、成長資金を調達する機会を引き続き見いだしていると述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米株、下半期の上昇基調維持に多くの試練　ＡＩ投資から金融政策まで コラム：ＡＩブームの恩恵受ける小型テック株、先行きは不透明 焦点：米市場けん引の半導体株、過熱懸念も アングル：スペースＸの大型ＩＰＯ、投資需要吸収され他社は上場困難に コラム：高市発言受け「ポジティブ修正」、衆院選後のドル／円相場を読む＝尾河眞樹氏 最終更新: 10/26(月) 23:46 ロイター

item.title: Wall Street cierra en alza ya que solicitud de OPI de Anthropic impulsa acciones de IA
item.description: Wall Street avanzó el lunes, y tanto el S&P 500 como el Nasdaq se recuperaron tras anotar caídas semanales consecutivas, ya que la solicitud de una oferta pública inicial (OPI) de Anthropic impulsó el optimismo en torno a las acciones relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial (IA).
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
item.content:encoded: Wall Street avanzó el lunes, y tanto el S&P 500 como el Nasdaq se recuperaron tras anotar caídas semanales consecutivas, ya que la solicitud de una oferta pública inicial (OPI) de Anthropic impulsó el optimismo en torno a las acciones relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial (IA). Anthropic reveló pérdidas considerables y un crecimiento vertiginoso de los ingresos en su solicitud de salida a bolsa en Estados Unidos, en la que expuso su ambición de crear sistemas de inteligencia artificial capaces de transformar la economía mundial a pesar de los altos costos que conlleva el desarrollo de la tecnología. El laboratorio de IA sigue adelante con sus planes de salida a bolsa a pesar de que el calendario de ofertas, que en otoño boreal solía estar repleto, se ha reducido, ya que la volatilidad del mercado ha llevado a las empresas a retrasar sus ofertas. La presentación de Anthropic se produce en un momento en que los inversores analizan con mayor detenimiento el posible retorno de las inversiones masivas en IA, justo al inicio de una semana intensa. Entre los eventos clave destacan el comunicado de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal el miércoles, los datos sobre crecimiento económico e inflación el jueves, y una serie de informes de resultados corporativos. Más de un tercio de las empresas que integran el índice S&P 500 tienen previsto presentar sus resultados esta semana, incluidas las grandes compañías tecnológicas Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) y Amazon.com (AMZN.O) . Sus cifras serán examinadas minuciosamente en busca de señales que indiquen si las cuantiosas inversiones en IA se están traduciendo efectivamente en crecimiento. Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) subió 53,35 puntos, O un 0,70%, a 7.677,03 unidades; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganó 214,02 puntos, o un 0,83%, a 26.169,38 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) sumó 146,60 puntos, o un 0,28%, a 52.361,76 unidades. Las firmas de semiconductores y chips, consideradas por muchos como algunas de las grandes beneficiadas del auge de la IA, contribuyeron a impulsar las subidas. El índice general de chips de Filadelfia (.SOX) escaló cera de un 3% en la sesión, aunque acumula una baja del 12% en el mes. Meta anunció el lunes que tiene previsto conseguir 95.000 millones de dólares de capital para financiar centros de datos, capacidad de computación en la nube y otras infraestructuras.

item.title: Jefa del árbitro electoral de México renuncia en medio de investigaciones por corrupción
item.description: La presidenta del árbitro electoral de México, Guadalupe Taddei, presentó el lunes su renuncia al cargo en medio de investigaciones por presunta corrupción, una decisión respaldada por la mandataria, Claudia Sheinbaum, quien descartó que el organismo atraviese una crisis de cara a las elecciones intermedias del próximo año.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La presidenta del árbitro electoral de México, Guadalupe Taddei, presentó el lunes su renuncia al cargo en medio de investigaciones por presunta corrupción, una decisión respaldada por la mandataria, Claudia Sheinbaum, quien descartó que el organismo atraviese una crisis de cara a las elecciones intermedias del próximo año. Taddei, quien asumió el cargo en abril de 2023, anunció su decisión de separarse del cargo asegurando que respondía a la necesidad de proteger la estabilidad, la credibilidad y la independencia del Instituto Nacional Electoral (INE). Su salida es la más significativa por un caso ligado a corrupción durante la gestión de Sheinbaum, iniciada en octubre de 2024. Además, plantea dudas sobre la credibilidad y el liderazgo de la autoridad electoral, luego de que los legisladores rechazaran a principios del año el intento más amplio de Sheinbaum de [USN:L1N3ZZ1D0 TEXT:"reformar el sistema electoral"]. Posteriormente, el Congreso, de mayoría oficialista, respaldó un paquete de cambios electorales más limitado. "No podía haber esta sombra de conflicto de interés, qué bueno que ella tomó esta decisión de separarse", dijo la mandataria el lunes en su habitual rueda de prensa matutina, y pidió esperar al resultado de las investigaciones sobre el caso. También desmintió que la renuncia implique una crisis política, al ser cuestionada por un reportero por el hecho de que sea la primera vez que la persona al frente del INE dimite en medio de un proceso electoral. México celebrará en junio de 2027 elecciones para renovar la Cámara de Diputados y más de la mitad de gubernaturas, en una contienda que servirá como prueba clave de la fuerza del partido oficialista Morena y la oposición, y que podría redefinir el equilibrio político rumbo a la sucesión presidencial de 2030. Además, son los primeros comicios bajo el mandato de Sheinbaum. CREDIBILIDAD DEL INE, BAJO ESCRUTINIO Según varios reportes publicados en medios de comunicación en las últimas semanas, Taddei habría favorecido con contratos millonarios a un proveedor del INE con el que tiene una relación personal. Además, las autoridades investigan por presunto fraude varios convenios firmados por otros funcionarios del instituto electoral en los que habría habido conflicto de interés. "Con la convicción de que el Instituto (INE) y sus responsabilidades constitucionales deben prevalecer por encima de cualquier interés personal, presento ante la Cámara de Diputados mi renuncia, con efectos a partir del día de hoy", escribió Taddei en una misiva enviada la tarde del lunes a la cámara baja. "Me retiro con serenidad, con la satisfacción del deber cumplido", agregó. Varios miembros de su familia han ocupado u ocupan puestos de distinta responsabilidad en gobiernos de la Cuarta Transformación, como se denomina al movimiento político al que pertenecen Sheinbaum y el expresidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador, quien durante su gestión impulsó la aprobación de una reforma constitucional para tipificar casos de corrupción como el de Taddei -señalada de ejercicio abusivo de funciones- como delito grave en el código penal, lo que puede implicar prisión preventiva para la funcionaria. "Se espera que las elecciones de 2027 sean muy disputadas y la credibilidad de INE es fundamental para evitar conflictos. Por eso, la salida de Taddei es una corrección necesaria y oportuna", opinó Antonio Ocaranza, consultor y exvocero el presidente Ernesto Zedillo (1994-2000). "Ya son muchos casos de familias políticas cercanas a Morena acusadas de corrupción y el Gobierno ha dado pocas deseos de investigarlos y castigarlos. Este será otro reto de credibilidad para el gobierno de la presidenta Sheinbaum", agregó. Tras recibir la renuncia de Taddei, la Cámara de Diputados inició la tarde del lunes el proceso para nombrar a su sucesor, un procedimiento que suele durar entre cuatro y cinco semanas y durante el cual el organismo será encabezado de manera provisional por uno de los consejeros del instituto. El lunes, la oposición aseguró que la sucesora de Taddei debería ser mujer y no estar ligada a Morena. "No puede utilizarse esta crisis para imponer a otro perfil cercano al gobierno de Morena, ni siquiera en la designación de quien asuma la Presidencia de manera provisional", dijo Alejandro Moreno, presidente del partido opositor PRI. "México no puede llegar a las elecciones de 2027 con un árbitro electoral cuya imparcialidad esté seriamente cuestionada", agregó.

item.title: 日本の外務省、ロシア拘束の北海道新聞記者と領事面会
item.description: [東京 ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[東京 ２６日 ロイター] - 日本の外務省は２６日、ロシアに拘束された北海道新聞記者に在ロシア日本大使館の職員が領事面会したと発表した。健康状態に問題はないという。

領事面会は、在外公館の領事官が外国で拘束された自国民と直接面会して状態を確認すること。

北海道新聞の記者は１３日にユジノサハリンスクで拘束され、その後にモスクワへ移送された。日本側は外務省の中村仁威欧州局長がロシアを訪れるなどして領事面会を働きかけたが、実現していなかった。

item.title: Mercados argentinos se derrumban tras resultado electoral en Brasil
item.description: La plaza financiera argentina se desplomó de manera generalizada el lunes acompañando el retroceso en los mercados de su principal socio económico, Brasil, luego de que se confirmara el inesperado triunfo del socialista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en las elecciones presidenciales del domingo.
item.dc:creator: Hernan Nessi, Jorge Otaola
item.content:encoded: La plaza financiera argentina se desplomó de manera generalizada el lunes acompañando el retroceso en los mercados de su principal socio económico, Brasil, luego de que se confirmara el inesperado [USN:L2N46C00P TEXT:"triunfo"] del socialista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en las elecciones presidenciales del domingo. La mayoría de los analistas y operadores de Argentina daban por descontada una victoria del libertario Flávio Bolsonaro, afín ideológicamente al mandatario argentino Javier Milei. El índice accionario MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de la bolsa porteña cayó un fuerte 2,91% al cierre, luego de derrumbarse más del 6% en la primera parte operativa, mientras que su par brasileño Bovespa (.BVSP) llegó a hundirme [USN:L2N46C0JZ TEXT:"más de un 17%."] La devaluación del real, moneda de Brasil, tiende a complicar la competitividad de la propia economía argentina. "El sorprendente resultado electoral no solo es una mala noticia para el mercado brasileño. El efecto contagio también afecta al Merval y bonos soberanos argentinos", expresó Roberto Geretto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero. "Por el lado macro, un real más débil pone presión al dólar al apreciar el tipo de cambio real multilateral", agregó. Al respecto, el peso mayorista argentino se depreció un 0,75% a 1.541 por dólar, tras tocar un mínimo histórico intradiario de 1.542 unidades para la venta, y los bonos en la ronda extrabursátil retrocedieron en promedio un 0,6%. El banco central (BCRA) no contabilizó intervención cambiaria, como se preveía, ante reservas provisorias en 50.481 millones de dólares. El riesgo país argentino saltaba a los 755 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), un nivel similar al registrado a fines de octubre del 2025. "Brasil se encamina a una dura jornada financiera (... con) marcada debilidad en la renta fija y una fuerte depreciación del real. Los mercados deberán desarmar las expectativas generadas por un posible triunfo de Bolsonaro y absorber un nuevo 'cisne negro': un hecho poco probable, pero de gran impacto", dijo el economista Gustavo Ber. "El contagio de dicho malhumor sobre los activos argentinos parece irreversible y que podría ser también importante (...) en un mundo que afrontará sucesivas elecciones relevantes en los próximos meses -entre ellas, en Israel, Estados Unidos y Francia-, la lección para los inversores vuelve a ser que todo pronóstico puede fallar", agregó. Argentina celebrará comicios presidenciales en 2027, donde Milei buscará su reelección.

item.title: ネタニヤフ氏、総選挙控えトランプ氏の支持誇示 再選ならイラン戦争再開と示唆

Steven Scheer Emily Rose
